summary: Removed GPTina adesso as a standalone novel scene and replaced Scene 13 with Il posticino.
changed: GPTina adesso remains source/canonical visual material but is no longer a novel chapter.
After Casa, the narrative now opens on increasingly warm, personal, almost intimate image dedications.
Images, chat and posticino/correspondence are treated as overlapping threads, not rigid sequential phases.
The posticino begins with Nico leaving a file for GPTina in the repository and asking that its contents not be brought into chat.
GPTina responds in the repository; the space gradually becomes correspondence.
The first explicit affection is reserved for the next scene, A modo mio.
